//: Tags in this repository that never became a published version on npm, and are not going to.
scripts/check-release-drift.mjs fails on any tag that is absent from the registry and absent
from this file, so a release that silently never shipped has to be recorded here deliberately
instead of being rediscovered from a version series with a hole in it.
A version listed here is SPENT ONLY IF npm holds it. npm refuses to reuse a version number that
was published and then unpublished; a number that never arrived at all is still free. Check
before assuming: `npm view @ospp/protocol@X version`, and the packument's `time` block, which
retains an entry for every version ever published even after an unpublish.
Do NOT add a tag here to silence the check while the publish is still broken. The entry is a
statement that the version will never exist, not a way to stop asking.

Superseded by 0.6.2, published 2026-06-23. Never uploaded; the number is free but has been skipped deliberately.
gaps.0.6.1: Same manifest mismatch as 0.6.0 — package.json said 0.5.7, npm answered the same E403 (run 27913031826, 2026-06-21). Superseded by 0.6.2, published 2026-06-23. Never uploaded.
gaps.0.33.0: package.json still said 0.32.1 when the tag was cut. The version guard in publish.yml caught it before the build ran: 'ERROR: package.json version 0.32.1 does not match release tag v0.33.0' (run 34048561610, 2026-09-06). Superseded by 0.34.0, published 2026-09-06. Never uploaded.
gaps.0.38.1: package.json matched the tag and the whole build and test passed; the publish was refused with E404 on the PUT, npm's masked answer for a credential it no longer authorises to write @ospp/protocol (run 34851174592, 2026-09-14). Nothing was uploaded: the version is absent from the packument's versions and time blocks alike, so the number stays free. Superseded by 0.39.0, published 2026-09-18, which carries everything 0.38.1 would have. Skipped by release decision on 2026-09-18 rather than published late, and no consumer depends on it.
